title: Can I use an MOI letter instead of IELTS? | SK Immigration Services
h1: Can I use an MOI letter instead of IELTS?
description: Medium of Instruction (MOI) letters instead of IELTS for study abroad from Pakistan: when universities accept them, when missions still doubt, and how to prepare a usable MOI.

faqs.question: Can MOI replace IELTS?
faqs.answer: Only if the university accepts MOI for your case and the visa file stays credible.

faqs.question: Should I still take IELTS?
faqs.answer: Yes when the offer requires it, or after prior language-related refusals.

body:
Answer: Sometimes. A Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter can replace IELTS when the university explicitly accepts it for your intake. It is not a universal Schengen waiver. Weak or homemade MOI letters fail both admission and visa credibility checks.

What a usable MOI usually includes

  • University/school letterhead and registrar contacts
  • Your full name matching passport
  • Program dates and confirmation that English (or stated language) was the medium
  • Stamp/signature; scan clarity for uploads

When MOI is rejected

SituationLikely result
Offer still lists IELTS as mandatoryMOI ignored
MOI from unrecognized schoolHigh refusal risk
English-taught offer + you cannot interview in EnglishCredibility failure

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to letter, instead, ielts, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “moi letter instead of ielts” files

  • Treating “moi letter instead of ielts” as a slogan instead of a document checklist
  • Transferring deposits before CUIN and written fee scope are confirmed
  • Copy-pasting another student’s SOP or bank story
  • Hiring anyone who sells a guaranteed visa outcome
